hero.title: Arthas
hero.tagline: Encrypted AirDrop + Ephemeral Chat. No signup, no trace, no compromise.
features.e2ee.title: End-to-End Encrypted
features.e2ee.description: Messages encrypted in your browser. The server never sees plaintext — zero knowledge by design.
features.nosignup.title: No Signup Required
features.nosignup.description: Create a room instantly. No email, no phone, no account. Just share the link and start chatting.
features.selfdestruct.title: Self-Destruct
features.selfdestruct.description: Rooms vanish when everyone leaves. No chat history stored anywhere — gone means gone.
features.filesharing.title: Encrypted File Sharing
features.filesharing.description: Send files peer-to-peer with end-to-end encryption. Like AirDrop, but works across any network.
features.voice.title: Voice Messages
features.voice.description: Record and send encrypted voice messages with push-to-talk. Crystal clear, fully private.
features.cli.title: CLI Client
features.cli.description: Chat from your terminal. Full encryption support, lightweight Go binary for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
features.openclaw.title: AI Agent Channel
features.openclaw.description: Connect AI agents to encrypted rooms. Zero-knowledge conversations — the server cannot observe prompts or responses.
trust.title: Built on Trust
trust.opensource.title: Open Source
trust.opensource.description: Every line of code is public and auditable. Verify the security yourself.
trust.zeroknowledge.title: Zero Knowledge
trust.zeroknowledge.description: The server is a blind relay. It forwards encrypted blobs without ever seeing your content.
trust.agpl.title: AGPL-3.0 Licensed
trust.agpl.description: Copyleft ensures all derivatives remain open. Your privacy is protected by law.
trust.servernothing.title: Server Sees Nothing
trust.servernothing.description: All encryption and decryption happens client-side. Keys never leave your device.
